title: Twin Quest Engine
subtitle: Game Engine & Reactive State Management
summary: Frontend reactive state architecture experiment and game rule engine implemented in TypeScript.
overview: Experimental project exploring advanced reactive state management patterns and strict TypeScript typing using Pinia in an interactive game engine interface.
responsibilities: Modeled complex state management using Pinia stores.
Decoupled core game rule domain logic from UI rendering components.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Reactive synchronization of multiple UI components without direct prop coupling.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Utilized strongly typed Pinia stores with immutable getters and actions.
